input_ref: Pharmacy advocate: whats the rx price disclamer for a 30 day preffered retail fill

output.reason: U-RX-EDU-001-09 fully answers the question. It is the full legal disclaimer for a 30-day preferred retail estimate: it is based on today's plan records, cost can change with the pharmacy, days' supply or coverage stage, and it is not a guarantee of payment. U-RX-EDU-002-07 says nearly the same thing, but the Legal-labeled unit is the better source for disclaimer wording. U-WEB-FAQ-01 is web page text and leaves out the cost-change and no-guarantee language.
